feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 November 2026 9:50pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 15 November 2026 at 9:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first and again later.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will build overnight.


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 later tonight. Becoming Variable 2 to 4 later tomorrow morning, then east or southeast 5 to 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate occasionally rough at first, falling slight or moderate overnight, then slight tomorrow morning. Building moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, rain spreading from the southwest later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 5 to 7, increasing 6 to gale 8 overnight, then becoming Cyclonic 4 to 6 on Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain developing spreading from the southwest, clearing later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
